children: RNS Number : 8983S  JPMorgan Claverhouse IT PLC  01 September 2026
APPOINTMENT OF CORPORATE BROKER AND FINANCIAL ADVISER

The Board of JPMorgan Claverhouse Investment Trust plc (the 'Company') is pleased to announce the appointment of Investec Bank plc to act as the Company's sole corporate broker and financial adviser, with immediate effect.
Will Barnett, Neil Brierley and Jack Kershaw (Sales)
